login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Book a load, follow your shipments and keep your documents in one place.
login.carrierNote: Your account is hosted by the carrier company that invited you. Booking a load sends the order straight to their dispatcher.
signup.title: Create your account
signup.lead: Two minutes, no paperwork: company details are optional and can be completed later.
signup.name: Your name
signup.verificationNote: Email and phone verification need a delivery provider that is not connected yet — your account works meanwhile and the portal shows the state honestly.
shipments.title: Shipments
shipments.lead: Everything you have booked, with the live status of the trip.
shipments.empty: No shipments yet. Book your first load and it appears here.
book.title: Book a load
book.lead: Route, cargo, dates — then choose how you want to ship it.
book.special: Reefer temperature, customs T1/TIR, loading help, appointment…
book.pay.invoice: On account — carrier invoices after POD
book.pay.escrowNote: Escrow needs the owner's merchant-of-record decision (UXF-OWN1); invoice-first is what works today.
book.sectionSupply: How do you want to ship this?
book.supply.lead: Every option is explained — nothing is a dead end.
book.supply.fleetDesc: Browse verified fleets: filter by lane, equipment, rating, ETA and price band.
book.supply.soloDesc: Beacon board of owner-operators: who is empty, where, and available from when.
book.supply.autoDesc: The engine ranks fleets and solo drivers by price, ETA, rating and reliability.
book.supply.ownCarrierDesc: Book directly with a carrier you already work with, on or off RoadwiseFleet.
book.supply.recurringDesc: Agreed rate card per lane with a weekly or monthly schedule.
book.supply.offPlatform: My carrier is not on RoadwiseFleet
book.supply.offPlatformDesc: We create the order here and send your carrier a job link by WhatsApp or SMS — they need no account.
book.carrierKind.on: Yes — send them the booking request
book.carrierKind.off: No — send them a job link
book.carrierKind.note: Either way the order is created and your dispatcher sees it immediately.
book.marketplacePending: The marketplace opens with UXF-M1 (#76). Your choice is recorded and nothing is lost — until then, book with your own carrier (on or off RoadwiseFleet) and the load goes to your dispatcher today.
book.marketplaceFallback: Book with my own carrier instead
book.offPlatformNote: Order created with a job link for your carrier.
book.created: Order created. Your carrier's dispatcher can see it now.
shipment.heading: Shipment
shipment.trackNone: No live tracking link yet — create one to share this shipment with your consignee.

account.teamLead: Everyone here can book and track for this account.

account.addressesLead: Saved addresses appear as suggestions when you book.
